notes: This file is the PUBLISH READY record of the external registry configuration. scripts/check_publication_readiness.py refuses publication while any project here is not VERIFIED, while any readback predates last_registry_failure, while the recorded publisher tuple is not the identity .github/workflows/release.yml presents, or while the recorded publisher kind disagrees with whether the project exists on the index. .github/workflows/release.yml runs that check before anything is built, before the human approval gate and again before the first upload; no tag exists until all of it has passed (ADR 0082).

Only the repository owner can fill this in. Verification means opening https://pypi.org/manage/account/publishing/ (for a project that does not exist yet) or the project's own Publishing settings (for one that does) and reading back the exact Project name and the four fields of the publisher tuple. A 404 on the project page is not evidence that a pending publisher exists, and the 0.1.0a6 failure proved that a readback which does not check the Project name field character by character is not evidence either.

To confirm a project: set trusted_publisher to VERIFIED, verified_by to the confirming human account and verified_on to the date of the readback, and set publisher_kind to pending (project absent from PyPI) or active (project exists). Then set status/confirmed_by/confirmed_on at the top. Record no credentials here. An automation identity in verified_by or confirmed_by is refused.
